rapidFire.name: Rapid fire rules
rapidFire.hint: Progressive Recoil rolls each shot separately with a cumulative Rcl penalty and no RoF bonus. Standard uses the Basic Set rules.

braceAcc.name: Bracing Acc bonus
braceAcc.hint: Added to every shot of a braced Progressive Recoil burst.

carryover.name: Aim carry-over (EUFC)
carryover.hint: A single shot keeps half its Acc bonus (all of it when braced) for the shooter's next turn against the same target.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger advantage (EUFC)
gunslinger.hint: Characters with a trait named Gunslinger get Acc without aiming and ignore the Move and Attack penalty.

dialog.title: Fire {weapon}
dialog.hint: Aim helps the first shot only. Bracing halves Rcl and adds its Acc to every shot.

mod.gunslingerMove: Gunslinger: no Move and Attack penalty
